data.title: Saylor’s Strategy Restarts Bitcoin Buying, Spending $370 Million
data.description: Strategy Inc. resumed Bitcoin purchases after a 10-week pause, returning to its signature accumulation strategy after the crypto bear market pressured its shares, weakened confidence in the financing model and prompted a balance-sheet overhaul.
